claims.text: The card documents natively multimodal reasoning: text+image (+audio/video comprehension) in, 1M context; image (4K tokens) + text (64K) out; served via app/API/Studio/Vertex/Search/Flow/NotebookLM; based on Gemini 3 Flash; knowledge cutoff January 2025.

Vendor evaluation: human side-by-side Elo plus AutoRater tables favouring 3.1 Flash Image over 2.5 Flash Image, 3 Pro Image, GPT-Image 1.5, Seedream 5.0 Lite, Grok Imagine Pro (with confidence intervals).

limitations.text: Card scope is model-specific; cross-model comparison prohibited; hallucinations; poor small/dense text, character-consistency gaps, doodle-ink persistence, spatial left/right confusion listed in-card.
